ai_summary: NOVA Global Opportunities Fund PCC - Touchstone has disclosed the sale of 275,193 shares, representing a 2.15% stake, in AAA Technologies Limited via an open market transaction. This disposal reduces their total shareholding from 8.68% to 6.53%, triggering a mandatory disclosure under SEBI regulations for a significant change in holding. A notable red flag is the transaction date, stated as September 16, 2026, which is in the future, suggesting a potential clerical error.
